before: A shorter vertical merge from the same row as a longer merge sized its own first row. Over rows that can grow, its text was clipped at that row or its rows were too tall.
after: Every merge from one row is sized together. Each merge grows its own last row, unless that row has an exact height. A head row that moves to the next page sizes its merges again there.
reason: The change is in table row layout only. Shared state, operations, and synchronization are unchanged.
